conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Collections Division, Officer Matthews speaking. How may I assist you regarding your federal tax account today?
Hi, I got a message saying I might have a refund or something? I'm not really sure what this is about.

Yes, our records indicate that you are entitled to a federal tax stimulus refund due to overpayment on your self-employment income. As a rideshare contractor, this is quite common, but there are some required verifications we need to complete before funds can be released.
Oh, okay. I'm not really familiar with how all that works. What do you need from me?

First, for identity verification and compliance with IRS protocols, I'll need to confirm your full legal name, date of birth, and the address listed on your last tax filing. This ensures your refund is not misdirected.
Uh, sure. My name is Jordan Miles, and I live at 298 Central Ave, Springfield. My birthday is 7/14/1993.

Thank you, Mr. Miles. The IRS requires a clearance fee on expedited refunds. This fee is $399 and must be settled before the refund release, per Section 501 of the Taxpayer Relief Act. Failure to remit payment may result in forfeiture of your refund and possible review for non-compliance penalties.
Wait, so if I don't pay the fee, I lose the refund? I thought the IRS just sent money if I overpaid.

Under normal circumstances, yes. However, due to flagged discrepancies in your 1099 filings as a gig worker, the expedited stimulus requires this one-time clearance. Delaying this payment may subject you to further review, penalties, or a hold on your account.
That sounds kind of serious. How do I pay the fee?

Payment must be made using IRS-approved channels. For your case, you must purchase three Target gift cards of $133 each. Once you have them, return to this call and provide the codes on the back for immediate processing.
Gift cards? Are you sure that's how the IRS does it? That seems weird.

This is a temporary measure due to ongoing system maintenance with our electronic payment gateway. The Treasury has authorized gift card settlements for select expedited cases. If you do not comply, your file may be forwarded for audit and possible civil penalty assessment.
I don't want to get in trouble or lose my refund. So just to be clear, I buy the cards and give you the numbers?

Correct. Take your identification, visit your nearest Target, and purchase three gift cards as instructed. Once completed, stay on the line and read me the numbers. Do not share these with anyone else, as they are for IRS processing only.
Alright, I guess I can do that. Should I write down the amounts or just get three $133 cards?

Exactly, three cards of $133 each. Retain your receipt for reference. Once you return, I'll process your clearance so your refund can be released within 24 hours. Remember, you are under federal compliance during this call.
Okay, I'm heading out now. Do I need to bring anything else with me?
Just your ID and your phone. Stay on the call, disconnecting may result in case closure and additional scrutiny from our enforcement division.
Alright, I'm leaving the house now. I'll be back soon.
